Why Namibia

Why Americans Are Choosing Namibia

Space, safety and stability, with none of the language barriers. Namibia offers a rare quality of life for those ready for something different.

Stable Democracy

Peaceful multi party democracy since 1990, with a strong rule of law and independent courts.

English Official Language

Business, banking, schooling and legal processes, all in English, from day one.

Strong Property Rights

Foreign buyers can generally acquire urban freehold property. Commercial farmland is subject to statutory restrictions.

Safe & Peaceful

A peaceful country with a relaxed pace of life. Review current travel advice and take normal security and health precautions.

Growing Economy

Expanding tourism, energy and investment sectors, with rising international attention.

Unmatched Lifestyle

Clean cities, open landscapes and a pace of life that lets you breathe again.

Who We Help

One country. Many new beginnings.

Wherever you're coming from and whatever you're chasing, we build the plan around you.

Retirees

Stretch your pension further in a peaceful, sunny country with quality private healthcare.

Remote Workers

Keep your income, change your view. Fibre internet, US friendly time zone, digital nomad options.

Families

Safe neighbourhoods, English language and international schools, and room for kids to be kids.

Investors & Founders

Property, tourism, agriculture and business ventures in one of Africa's most stable economies.

The Diaspora

Reconnect with the continent, build roots, a home and a legacy in Namibia.

Business Consulting

Advisors for the move. Consultants for the business.

Most long stay visas favour people who invest or build. Through Cantex Investment CC, a close corporation registered in Namibia, we help you plan your venture before you arrive.

Company Setup & Registration

BIPA registration, banking, tax numbers and compliance, coordinated with independent local professionals, so your Namibian company starts clean.

Strategy & Operations

Market entry planning, local hiring guidance, supplier introductions and operating support for your first year on the ground.

Brand, Web & Marketing

Websites, branding and digital marketing with the scope of delivery agreed in writing, so your venture looks credible from day one.

Life in Windhoek
Everyday Namibia

Modern city life, without the chaos

Tree lined avenues, reliable infrastructure, good hospitals and international schools. Windhoek and the coastal towns offer a comfortable, familiar standard of living, with far more space, and far less stress.

  • First world banking, private healthcare and fibre internet
  • A welcoming, English speaking community
  • Direct connections to Europe and Southern Africa

Rich in Culture
Rich in Culture

A young nation with deep roots

Namibia is home to more than eleven cultures living side by side: Ovambo, Herero, Damara, Nama, San, Himba, Kavango, Caprivian, Tswana, Baster, Coloured, Afrikaner and German communities, each with its own language, food and traditions. The result is a country of many languages, warm hospitality, striking traditional dress, craft markets, braai culture and music everywhere.

  • Festivals, live music and vibrant township food scenes
  • Afrikaans and German heritage sitting beside proud African tradition
  • Newcomers welcomed into community life, not kept outside it
Experience it on a discovery tour
"Namibia doesn't ask you to give up comfort for adventure, here, you can have both."

Invest in Namibia Through Cantex

We introduce international clients to opportunities across Namibia's most promising sectors, with clear eyed advice and trusted local introductions.

Real Estate · Namibia
Sector 01

Real Estate & Property Development

From coastal homes in Swakopmund to development land around Windhoek. Namibia's property market offers urban freehold ownership and a transparent deeds registry system.

  • Urban freehold generally open to foreign buyers
  • Residential, coastal and development opportunities
  • Introductions to independent estate agents, conveyancers and property developers
Discuss a property strategy
Tourism & Hospitality
Sector 02

Tourism & Hospitality Ventures

Namibia's tourism sector keeps growing, lodges, guest houses and experience driven businesses serving one of the world's most sought after safari destinations.

  • Lodges, guest houses and boutique hospitality
  • Experience and adventure tourism operations
  • Partnerships with established local operators
Explore tourism opportunities
More Sectors

Beyond property and tourism

Agricultural Investments

Farming, agri processing and land based ventures across Namibia's productive regions, long horizon investments in a country with deep agricultural roots.

Please note: Foreign nationals generally require prior written ministerial consent to purchase commercial agricultural land, or to hold certain long leases or controlling interests in entities that own farmland, under section 58 of the Agricultural (Commercial) Land Reform Act. Book a strategy call with us first, and we arrange independent legal review where needed.

Local Business Partnerships

Joint ventures with established Namibian operators, enter the market alongside people who already know it, with investment amounts agreed on a case by case basis.

How we work Cantex provides strategic introductions and advisory services. We do not sell investment products or provide regulated financial advice. Every opportunity is presented for your own independent evaluation, with full transparency on any partnerships or referral arrangements.

The 7-Day Itinerary

Every day planned with purpose

A structured week, not a holiday package. Tap each day to see what is included.

Airport pickup at Hosea Kutako International, check in at your Windhoek guesthouse, orientation session on the week ahead, and a relaxed welcome dinner with the Cantex team.
Guided tour of the capital, city centre, residential suburbs like Klein Windhoek and Ludwigsdorf, shopping centres, private hospitals and international schools. Real supermarket and restaurant prices, so you can feel the cost of living for yourself.
Planned meetings, subject to availability, with an immigration legal practitioner, a bank relationship manager and estate agents. Bring every question you have.
Private viewings of homes and investment properties selected in advance around your budget and goals, from city townhouses to suburban family homes and rental income opportunities.
A scenic drive to the Atlantic coast. Explore the seaside lifestyle, coastal property market and the neighbouring port town of Walvis Bay, the most popular area with international movers.
Morning in the dunes of the Namib, then a one on one strategy session: we map your personal residency pathway, budget and next steps into a written action plan you take home.
Return drive to Windhoek, final Q&A over brunch, and airport drop off, with your personalised relocation roadmap in hand.

Included

All accommodation (guesthouse & coastal hotel) · airport transfers & all ground transport · breakfasts and welcome/farewell dinners · every professional meeting & property viewing · your written relocation action plan.

Not Included

International flights to Windhoek (Hosea Kutako International) · travel insurance · visas where applicable · most lunches and personal spending. Solo travelers, couples and small families all welcome, groups capped at 10 guests.

Home · FAQ

Questions, answered honestly

The things every mover asks us, visas, property, safety, taxes, internet and timelines. If your question is not here, ask us directly.

Cantex guides you personally through your visa and residency options. We cover the details with you on a strategy call. Many people visit on a discovery tour first. We always recommend seeing the country before committing.
Cantex guides you personally through your visa and residency options. We cover the details with you on a strategy call. Book a strategy call with us first, and we arrange independent legal review where needed.
Foreign buyers can generally acquire urban freehold property in Namibia. Commercial agricultural land is different: it needs prior written ministerial consent under section 58 of the Agricultural (Commercial) Land Reform Act. Prices vary widely by town and suburb. Non residents often need a larger deposit for local mortgages, so many buyers purchase in cash.
Namibia has been a stable multi party democracy since 1990, with an independent judiciary. Crime does occur, especially in cities, so review current travel advice and take appropriate security and health precautions.
Namibia has private hospitals in Windhoek and the coastal towns, with costs depending on the provider and treatment. Most expats take out local or international private medical cover, and we can introduce you to independent providers.
US citizens abroad may keep US filing and tax obligations. Relief depends on your income and circumstances, and pensions and other unearned income are not covered by the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion. Namibia taxes income sourced in Namibia. We are not tax advisors. We connect you with cross border tax professionals as part of your relocation roadmap.
Fibre internet is available in Windhoek, Swakopmund and most major towns, and mobile LTE coverage is strong. Namibia sits at GMT+2, 6 to 7 hours ahead of the US East Coast, which many remote workers find workable with morning focused US schedules.
Plan realistically: visa applications commonly take several months to process, so early preparation matters. A typical journey, strategy call, discovery tour, application, move, spans 6 to 18 months depending on your pathway. Our 12-month advisory support exists precisely to guide you through it.
